correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all 20 graph vertices and 40 incidences, every graph distance, and all 20 witness-ball sets. At r=1 enumerated exactly 430 nonempty nerve faces and 130 valid elementary free-face pairs, yielding residual f-vector (20,80,70); exact signed integral unit-pivot boundary ranks (19,55). At r=2 enumerated 81,233 faces and 39,641 free-face pairs, yielding residual f-vector (19,159,558,811,404); exact integral ranks (18,141,417,389). Every integer diagonalization completed with only unit pivots and zero final block, so no torsion. Independent GF2 reduction confirmed ranks. At r=0 the nerve is 20 discrete vertices; at r>=3 a single radius-three ball contains all vertices. Integer graph distances and degree-disjoint adjacent nontrivial homology support yield the complete barcode. This is an exhaustive fixed finite graph proof, not an inference from sampled examples.

originality.rationale: Adams-Shukla-Singh concern general vertex-neighborhood scale correspondence and hypercube Cech homotopy; Matsushita studies general closed-neighborhood suspension comparison. Independent Resultary search found different exact graph Cech complexes (icosahedron, Desargues, Tutte-Coxeter, Pappus) but not this fixed Folkman-graph integral table. In particular ordinary Vietoris-Rips complexes, open neighborhoods and odd graph-geometric Cech scales are different constructions. Best-of-knowledge not subsumed.

value.rationale: Folkman is a canonical smallest semisymmetric regular graph, and full integral barcodes of its natural vertex-neighborhood nerve are an independently useful exact invariant; the two consecutive mixed-dimensional stages and absence of torsion are not evident from generic graph parameters. A finite but exhaustive classification can be valuable.

final_claim: For the 20-vertex doubled-subdivision K5 Folkman graph, closed vertex-ball nerve W_r has reduced H_0=Z^19 for 0<=r<1; reduced H_1=Z^6,H_2=Z^15 for 1<=r<2; reduced H_3=Z^5,H_4=Z^15 for 2<=r<3; contractible for r>=3. All integral homology torsion-free, and all-field persistence bars follow.
